title: Triceps Extension Machine
summary: A seated machine triceps extension with your elbows on a pad, for steady, isolated triceps work.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for triceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly triceps total.

setup.text: Sit with your elbows on the pad, lined up with the pivot.
Extend the handles until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your elbows are fully bent.

form_cues.cue: Push the handles to full lockout
Keep the elbows on the pad
Keep your shoulders down. Let the elbows do all the work.

mistakes.text: Lifting the shoulders to push with the chest.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Triceps long-head bias.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Triceps long-head bias, Steadier cable tension.
Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Peak-contraction focus, Less isolation.
